we present the design of two Oscillator based PUsF on Flash FPGAS and that the design is efficient in terms of area, speed and reliability.

the implementation of the Oscillator based PUs on Flash FPGAS.
the implementation and characterization of Ring Oscillator PUF and Transient Effect Ring PUF on Flash FPGA.
the design of efficient PUFs on FPGA for IoT devices.

the implementation of Oscillatory based Physical Unclonalable Functions (PUF) on Flash FPGA is feasible.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully implemented two PUFs on a low-cost FPGA.

the design practices presented in this work allow to obtain a high quality PUF implementation on flash based FPGA.

the design practices presented here can be applied to any Oscillator based PPU to obtain a fully functional implementation.
